arcs.title: Concord Navy
arcs.blurb: Hold the line for the Concord against the Free Reach.

entry.lead: Commander Idris Hale is recruiting at the Halcyon bar.

legacy.text: Navy veteran: your old commander sends 5,000 cr to every new pilot.

arcs.title: Free Reach Rising
arcs.blurb: Break the Concord's grip and open the lanes for the Free Reach.

entry.lead: Organiser Mara Quell is looking for pilots at the Dunmore Crossing bar.

legacy.text: Reach friend: every new pilot starts in a Courier, a gift from the Compact.

arcs.title: The Syndicate
arcs.blurb: Own the rim's lanes for the Hollow Syndicate.

entry.lead: Dockfixer Nell Corbin has work for a pilot who doesn't ask questions, at the Merrow bar.

legacy.text: Old favours: every new pilot starts with 7,500 cr of the Syndicate's laundered money.
